analyst.summary: CE Info Systems (MapmyIndia) is India's leading indigenous digital-mapping company with a real data and policy moat, but FY26 growth stalled sharply -- revenue grew just 2% and profit actually declined 9%, a marked slowdown from its historical 19-25% growth rates, and a meaningful share of even that reduced profit came from interest income on cash rather than core operations. At roughly 48-64 times earnings, the stock is still priced for a growth rate it did not deliver this past year. We rate this a Sell pending evidence of reacceleration.
